title: Understanding Pruning
text: Pruning a decision tree involves removing branches that have little importance. Think about how this might affect the tree's ability to fit the training data closely.

title: Bias and Complexity
text: Consider how reducing the complexity of a model, like pruning a decision tree, might affect its bias. Does a simpler model tend to have higher or lower bias?

title: Effect of Pruning on Bias
text: When you prune a decision tree, does it generally increase or decrease the bias of the model?
